props.name: Mold temperature controller
props.summary: Circulates temperature-controlled water or oil through the mold to hold a stable mold surface temperature.

props.name: Dehumidifying dryer
props.summary: Dries hygroscopic resins (PA, PC, PET, PBT, ABS) with low-dew-point air from a desiccant rotor.

props.name: Hot air dryer
props.summary: Removes surface moisture from non-hygroscopic resins (PP, PE, PS) using heated ambient air.

props.name: Chiller
props.summary: Supplies chilled water to molds and machine oil coolers using a refrigeration circuit.

props.name: Mold dehumidifier
props.summary: Blankets the mold area with dry air to stop condensation when molds run with chilled water.

props.name: Conveying system
props.summary: Vacuum loaders and centralized conveying that move resin from storage or dryers to machines.

props.name: Recycling granulator
props.summary: Beside-the-press and central granulators that regrind sprues, runners and rejects for reuse.
